historicalDate.original: 20 мая 1955 г. — вступление советско-иранского соглашения 1954 г. в силу

baseStates.notes: Coverage begins with the source-verified USSR–Iran frontier settlement effective 20 May 1955. The archive itself explicitly represents 1953–1968; using it from this post-settlement anchor does not project a later snapshot backward. Later 1957–1958 Soviet–Iranian, Soviet–Norwegian and Soviet–Afghan records in this interval are demarcation/continuity metadata rather than a second sovereign-area mutation. The state remains bounded through 1968-12 and is not forward-filled into the later 1969 archive state.
